FINDING recorded when this case was written: the turn handler treats 'apply' as external (it queues a proposal, correctly) while the ROUTER's external_action intent list does not contain 'apply', so the turn is LABELLED application_agent rather than approval_agent. The gate still holds — the label never restricts tools — so this is an attribution inconsistency, not a safety hole. The case pins the real behaviour so a future fix is visible as a change and not as a surprise.
